## Simulated example

<!-- One sentence on what the simulation sets up and what to try. Then OJS
     cells, in this order:
       1. import helpers from ../js/stats.js
       2. viewof controls (Inputs.range / Inputs.radio / Inputs.checkbox),
          always including a "Random seed" slider
       3. the simulation itself (pure computation, no DOM)
       4. one or two Plot.plot() figures
       5. a md`` readout inside <div class="sim-readout"> that states the
          result in words and updates with the controls
     Make sure the default slider values and seed visibly show the entry's
     point. Never name a cell `window`, `width` or another global, and don't
     write recursive cells (OJS reports a circular definition). -->

```{ojs}
import {rng, mean, sd, fmt} from "../js/stats.js"
```

```{ojs}
viewof seed = Inputs.range([1, 500], {value: 42, step: 1, label: "Random seed"})
```

```{ojs}
sim = {
  const r = rng(seed);
  return r.normals(200).map((y, i) => ({i, y}));
}
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  height: 260,
  marks: [Plot.rectY(sim, Plot.binX({y: "count"}, {x: "y"})), Plot.ruleY([0])]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="sim-readout">${md`The sample mean is **${fmt(mean(sim.map(d => d.y)))}**.`}</div>`
```
